translation_notes: ds.graph(rdflib.URIRef(iri)) is designated with `@graph EXPR` (its value at that line -- a fresh call each time the function runs), rather than assigned then reused, since the function has a single write

Literal(iri) is a plain literal built from a str with no explicit datatype, so it is identical to the default coercion of a bare interpolation {iri}: rewritten as such rather than kept as an explicit Literal(...) call
the rewrite drops the manual Namespace/Literal/.add() plumbing to a three-line pattern
